adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code fetches new tokens (lines 72-87), parses them with parseRefreshTokenResponse (line 89), updates the database with the new tokens (lines 95-98), but then returns a jsforce.Connection initialized with `accessToken: credentialKey.access_token` (line 106). The `credentialKey` variable was set before the refresh operation and contains the old/stale access token.
